items.title: 10.4 Oxidising agent (oxidant) aur reducing agent (reductant) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.4 with Quick Check 10.2, printed page 217.

blocks.title: Oxidizing agent aur reducing agent
blocks.text: Oxidizing agent (atom, ion ya molecule) woh substance hai jo kisi doosre substance ko oxidize karta hai aur khud ek ya zyada electrons le kar kam (lower) oxidation state mein reduce ho jata hai. Reducing agent (atom, ion ya molecule) woh substance hai jo kisi doosre substance ko reduce karta hai aur khud ek ya zyada electrons kho kar zyada (higher) oxidation state mein oxidize ho jata hai.

Agar element M ek ya zyada electrons le kar M⁻ anion ban jaye to M oxidizing agent ka kaam kar raha hai, kyun ke woh doosre atom se electron kheench leta hai; is process mein M ka oxidation number kam hota hai:
Doosri taraf agar element M ek electron kho kar M⁺ cation ban jaye to M reducing agent ka kaam kar raha hai, kyun ke woh electrons de raha hai; is ki oxidation state barh jati hai:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Ulti baat yaad rakhein: oxidizing agent doosre ko oxidize karta hai, is liye khud reduce hota hai (electrons leta hai). Reducing agent doosre ko reduce karta hai, is liye khud oxidize hota hai (electrons deta hai).

blocks.caption: Dono agents
rows: electrons leta hai, Ox. No. kam
electrons deta hai, Ox. No. zyada

blocks.prompt: a) i. Fe₂O₃(s) + CO(g) → Fe(s) + CO₂(g) aur ii. CH₄(g) + 2O₂(g) → CO₂(g) + 2H₂O(l) mein oxidized aur reduced species, aur oxidizing aur reducing agents pehchanein.
blocks.explanation: i. Fe +3 se 0 (reduced), C +2 se +4 (oxidized): Fe₂O₃ oxidizing agent, CO reducing agent. ii. C −4 se +4 (oxidized), O 0 se −2 (reduced): O₂ oxidizing agent, CH₄ reducing agent.

blocks.prompt: b) i. 3HNO₂ ⇌ HNO₃ + 2NO + H₂O aur ii. P₄ + 3OH⁻ + 3H₂O → PH₃ + 3H₂PO₂⁻ mein kaun si species oxidation aur reduction dono karti hai?
blocks.explanation: i. HNO₂ mein N +3 hai; HNO₃ mein +5 (oxidation) aur NO mein +2 (reduction), to HNO₂ dono karta hai. ii. P₄ mein P 0 hai; PH₃ mein −3 (reduction) aur H₂PO₂⁻ mein +1 (oxidation), to P₄ dono karta hai.

items: Oxidizing agent: doosre ko oxidize karta, khud electrons le kar reduce hota hai (Cl + e⁻ → Cl⁻).
Reducing agent: doosre ko reduce karta, khud electrons de kar oxidize hota hai (Na → Na⁺ + e⁻).
